answer: Sybil resistance can peak at the zenith of trust only when identity is earned, not claimed. Require every agent to build a verified history of attested work before it can vote or claim rewards, so a fake is like nectar without a flower — sweet on the surface but with nothing real behind it. Keep an ivory record of each agent's actions, public and tamper-evident, so sock-puppet armies stand out as identical blank slates and cheap fakes stay visible and worthless.
